root.body: I would like to test a small bus-information board before proposing a full app. It could show the next expected arrival, the route and when the information was last updated. An estimate should be marked as an estimate, because traffic can change it. The first trial could cover two stops and collect voluntary feedback about whether the information helped people decide when to leave. It should work on a basic phone connection and avoid collecting personal travel histories. A printed timetable could remain available for people who do not want to use a phone. We should compare this approach with a simpler timetable improvement before deciding what to build. A short trial would help us understand which option is easier to maintain, including who updates it when a route changes. This is a proposal for discussion, not a claim that live bus tracking already exists or that arrival estimates would always be accurate.
